tasks.subject: Task 1: TransmitMode enum + denoise()
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the `TransmitMode` enum and a denoise-only path on `TransmitProcessor` (suppressor per 10 ms sub-frame, no VAD, no gate) for the PTT held-audio path.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitMode.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessor.kt`
- Test: `app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessorTest.kt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `TransmitMode` enum with `VOICE_ACTIVATED` and `PUSH_TO_TALK`.
- [ ] `TransmitProcessor.denoise(capturePcm)` runs the suppressor once per 10 ms sub-frame; no gate.
- [ ] Test proves suppressor offsets `0` and `FRAME_SAMPLES_10MS`, gate stays closed.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home"; ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "me.danielstiner.dumble.mumble.voice.TransmitProcessorTest"` → BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

**Steps:** See plan §Task 1. Create enum; add failing denoise test; add denoise(); pass; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Engine push-to-talk transmit logic
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make `AudioVoiceEngine.nextOutgoingFrame()` honor `TransmitMode`: VA unchanged; PTT denoises and transmits only while `pttHeld`, gate bypassed, one silent terminator on release and on a live mode switch.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt`
- Test: `app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngineTransmitModeTest.kt` (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `initialTransmitMode` ctor param; `setTransmitMode(mode)` + `setPttHeld(value)`.
- [ ] PTT not held → `null`.
- [ ] PTT held → one non-terminator frame per capture.
- [ ] PTT release edge → exactly one terminator (`length>0`), then `null`.
- [ ] Mid-transmit mode switch → one closing terminator.
- [ ] Existing `AudioVoiceEngineFrameNumberTest` still passes.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home"; ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "me.danielstiner.dumble.mumble.voice.AudioVoiceEngine*"` → BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

**Steps:** See plan §Task 2. Add 4 PTT tests; add mode fields/setters (pendingClose, pttWasSending, sending); rewrite nextOutgoingFrame with terminatorFrame/encodeAndCount helpers; full engine suite green; commit.
